# anthropic Provider

The Anthropic provider is used to interact with the Anthropic service.

If you find this provider useful, please consider supporting me through GitHub Sponsorship or Ko-Fi to help with its development.

[![Github-sponsors](https://img.shields.io/badge/sponsor-30363D?style=for-the-badge&logo=GitHub-Sponsors&logoColor=#EA4AAA)](https://github.com/sponsors/jianyuan)
[![Ko-Fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ko--fi-F16061?style=for-the-badge&logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/L3L71DQEL)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the Anthropic provider
provider "anthropic" {
  api_key = "sk-ant-adminxx-xxxxx-xxxxx-xxxxx-xxxxx"
}

# Create a new workspace
resource "anthropic_workspace" "example" {
  name = "Workspace Name"
}

# Retrieve a user by ID
data "anthropic_user" "example" {
  id = "user_xxxxx"
}

# Add a user to the workspace
resource "anthropic_workspace_member" "example" {
  workspace_id   = anthropic_workspace.example.id
  user_id        = data.anthropic_user.example.id
  workspace_role = "workspace_developer"
}
```

```terraform
# Authenticate a Scalr run through workload identity federation instead of a
# long-lived token. Scalr sets TF_VAR_SCALR_OIDC_TOKEN to a fresh OIDC token
# in each run phase. Declaring the variable ephemeral (Terraform 1.10 or later)
# keeps the token out of the saved plan, so the apply phase exchanges its own.
variable "SCALR_OIDC_TOKEN" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

provider "anthropic" {
  federation_rule_id = "fdrl_xxxxx"
  organization_id    = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  service_account_id = "svac_xxxxx"
  identity_token     = var.SCALR_OIDC_TOKEN
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The Admin API key for authentication. Get this from the [Anthropic console](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/admin-keys). It can be sourced from the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) The OAuth bearer token for authentication. Log in with the `ant` CLI under a dedicated profile with the `org:admin` scope (see [Admin access](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/cli-sdks-libraries/cli/authentication#admin-access)), then export the bearer token. It can be sourced from the `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` environment variable. Conflicts with workload identity federation.
- `base_url` (String) API endpoint for the Anthropic service. Defaults to `https://api.anthropic.com`. It can be sourced from the `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` environment variable.
- `federation_rule_id` (String) The ID (`fdrl_...`) of the federation rule used to exchange `identity_token` or `identity_token_file` for a short-lived OAuth token through workload identity federation. Replaces `auth_token`. It can be sourced from the `ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID` environment variable.
- `identity_token` (String, Sensitive) The OIDC identity token (JWT) to exchange, such as Scalr's `SCALR_OIDC_TOKEN`. Pass it through an ephemeral variable so that each run phase uses its own token. The provider re-exchanges the same token shortly before the minted OAuth token expires, which the issuer rejects once the token has expired or, with `check_jti`, been used, so keep runs shorter than the minted token's lifetime. Conflicts with `identity_token_file`. It can be sourced from the `ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN` environment variable, which is re-read on every exchange.
- `identity_token_file` (String) The path to a file holding the OIDC identity token (JWT) to exchange. The file is re-read on every exchange, so a rotated token is picked up. Conflicts with `identity_token`. It can be sourced from the `ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE` environment variable.
- `organization_id` (String) The UUID of the Anthropic organisation the federation rule belongs to. Required with `federation_rule_id`. It can be sourced from the `ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID` environment variable.
- `service_account_id` (String) The ID (`svac_...`) of the service account a service-account federation rule targets. Optional; the exchange fails if the rule targets a different service account. It can be sourced from the `ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID` environment variable.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID (`wrkspc_...`), or `default`, of the workspace the exchanged token is scoped to. Required only when the federation rule covers more than one workspace. It can be sourced from the `ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID` environment variable.
